▫️Julia ima više od milion korisnika, Dyad 3.0 cilja dizajn hardvera▫️

▫️Julia выросла из проекта MIT в язык с более чем 1 млн пользователей▫️

➡️➡️➡️
JuliaHub has launched Dyad 3.0, an AI platform for engineering teams, as Julia surpasses 1 million users worldwide. The new release is intended to help develop complex physical systems including rockets, heat pumps and satellites.

Dyad lets engineers direct autonomous agents through physics simulations, safety analysis and quality controls. JuliaHub says its physics compiler detects solutions that violate physical laws and guides agents toward physically correct alternatives.

For my business, the practical lesson is to assess agentic engineering tools alongside validation workflows, domain data and accountable human review rather than treating generated designs as final.

#agenticai #engineering #julia #physics


➡️➡️➡️
Programski jezik Julia, nastao iz istraživačkog projekta na MIT-u, danas ima više od milion korisnika u hiljadama kompanija i univerziteta. JuliaHub je u aprilu predstavio Dyad 3.0, AI platformu za razvoj složenih fizičkih sistema, od raketa i toplotnih pumpi do satelita.

Julia kombinuje jednostavnost rada nalik Pythonu ili MATLAB-u sa performansama C-a. Ključ je just-in-time kompajliranje prema tipu podataka, pa se jezik koristi za simulacije, analizu podataka, modele lekova, aviona i finansijskih tržišta.

Dyad 3.0 usmerava autonomne agente kroz simulacije fizike, bezbednosne analize i kontrolu kvaliteta, uz proveru fizičkih ograničenja. Za poslovne timove zaključujemo da je vrednost ovakvih alata u kraćem putu od inženjerske ideje do proverljivog dizajna.

#julia #vestackainteligencija #inzenjering #automatizacija


➡️➡️➡️
Язык Julia, созданный в MIT для научных вычислений, насчитывает более 1 млн пользователей в тысячах компаний и университетов. Его применяют для моделирования лекарств, двигателей, финансовых рынков, роботов и других сложных систем.

Ключевая особенность Julia — JIT-компиляция с учетом типов данных: она должна сочетать удобство Python и MATLAB со скоростью C. Исследователи использовали язык, в частности, для задач по климату, нейронаукам и предотвращению столкновений самолетов.

В апреле JuliaHub выпустила Dyad 3.0 — ИИ-платформу для инженерного проектирования. Компания заявляет, что агенты могут обрабатывать документы и данные, проводить физические симуляции, проверки безопасности и качества.

Для бизнеса мы видим практический ориентир: автоматизацию сложной инженерии стоит связывать с проверяемыми физическими моделями и контролем результатов, а не ограничивать универсальным ИИ.

#julia #programming #engineering #artificialintelligence

🚀 From 100,000 learners worldwide to the top 4,500 — and Project 1 is officially passed!

I’m grateful to have been selected as one of the top 4,500 learners globally to receive a fully funded Nanodegree scholarship through the AWS AI & ML Scholars program with Udacity, following the 2026 Challenge Phase that supported 100,000 learners worldwide.

I’m currently completing the Future AWS Agent Engineer track, and I’ve now passed my first hands-on project. 🎉

For the project, I built an agentic customer-support solution that can understand different types of requests, conduct multi-turn conversations, securely use tools to take actions, ground responses in provided information, and hand off requests when appropriate.

I also went beyond the core scenarios by testing prompt-injection attempts, incomplete inputs, and tool-use edge cases, finishing with a 1.000 Correctness score across different LLM-as-a-judge evaluation scenarios.

My biggest takeaway has been that building useful AI systems is about much more than prompting a model. It requires thinking about how AI interacts with applications, data and tools — and how those interactions are secured, tested and evaluated.

While this project was implemented using AWS, those are skills and design principles I’m excited to carry across cloud platforms, enterprise systems and AI-enabled workflows.

I’ve documented the project, architecture and implementation on GitHub:
https://lnkd.in/gWMdrsaf

On to the next build. 🚀

A couple of months back I had a dodgy ankle and I found myself asking Gemini for advice which really got me thinking about something. Why am I giving such personal information to Google when I know the product is free because they are farming my data.

That's when I started building my own private AI agent. I spent rather a lot of time working on building the agent, just as an exercise in learning about how AI agents are built. Two weeks later I had a basic functional agent engine in Rust and deployed it on the edge for the best performance worldwide. With more work I managed to build a nice web application and I've even started started  building a native iOS app.

It got me thinking that I could probably just open up the agent to the public. The problem then is that, I could potentially see other user's chats, which would go against everything I built the agent for. So when I built out the authentication engine I created tooling for a "zero-access encryption" solution. All chats are encrypted using the user's authentication credentials. All that I can see in the database is a bunch of encrypted data. The caveat here is that if you loose your password or a backup key, you loose your chat history.

The application will always be free and signing up get's more limits and unlocks features like tracking chat history and memories. There's also a paid subscription for the pro tier of users with a much higher usage limit, but it's not required. Pro tier memberships will essentially pay for the free tier usage for rather a lot of users. 

I've also now built the second privacy tool, an email relay tools that acts as the intermediary between a website and your real email. It strips out tracking codes, rebuilds shortened URLs and has a sophisticated blocking mechanism. The email relay is still an early phase right now and while it works, some tracking code removal and shortened URLs might still remain in emails. 

These are really just tools I wanted to use myself, but I have a few more privacy tools in mind. I'd love to eventually provide 5 or 6 really good tools with a core focus on privacy. 

Go and checkout Blot Tools and if anyone has feedback I'd love to know: https://blot.tools/
